channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Xavier defeats Cleveland State in basketball game
item.description: Xavier University secured a 75-67 victory over Cleveland State University in a basketball game. The win for Xavier was described as a survival of a scare from Cleveland State. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Toronto Maple Leafs General Manager John Chayka has described the team's recent skid as 'unacceptable' and stated he is open to making trades, particularly for defensemen. He also expressed support for head coach Jim Hiller. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The U.S. women's national hockey team defeated Canada 6-2 to win the World Championship. Veteran Hilary Knight scored two goals in the victory, securing the team's second consecutive championship title. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Romelu Lukaku, Belgium's all-time top scorer, has announced his retirement from international football. The decision marks the end of his career representing the Belgian national team. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
